01 / CONTRIBUTION

Flutter app development

Developed the Flutter app presented through the public Qurani showcase. Application source is maintained privately; the public materials provide the current product screens and Android build.

  • Built the Arabic-first mobile experience around prayer times, Quran reading, adhkar, tasbih and Qibla guidance.
  • Provided a public Android APK and current product screens for hands-on review.
Scope & status

A public Android APK is available through the presentation repository. No app-store publication is claimed. More detailed architecture and ownership breakdown are not documented in the public source.
